audit.reason: Earlier Galaxy end-to-end measurements did not record or enforce a single-tab preflight. Old watch/settings tabs were found to retain stale Pinia/localStorage state and could also retain workers, MSE, decoders, or canvas work.
audit.disposition: These reruns replace earlier absolute Galaxy LAN end-to-end latency values. Earlier same-tab A/B and subsystem tests remain separate evidence but are not promoted to clean absolute device latency unless their tab state was recorded.
